question: When is National Sports Day celebrated in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**29 August**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The National Sports Day: 

 
 
• August 29 is the birthday of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand and is celebrated as the National Sports Day in India.
 
• The government of India designated August 29 as the National Sports Day in 2012 to commemorate his birth anniversary.
 
• This day aims to spread awareness of the importance of sports in every individual's life.
 
 
 
• Major Dhyan Chand:
 
 
• He was an Indian hockey player.
 
• His autobiography is called Goal*.*
 
• He was honoured with the Padma Bhushan in 1956.
 
• He is the only Indian hockey player to have a stamp in his honour.
 
• During his time, the Indian hockey team won three Olympic gold medals in 1928, 1932, and 1936.
 
• He is also known as '**The Wizard**'.
 
 
 
• On this day, the President of India honours eminent sports personalities with major awards including Khel Ratna, Arjuna Awards, Dronacharya Awards and Dhyan Chand Award.
